deploy.panel.title: Publish
deploy.panel.desc: Put your site on your own server. Somnia asks you before every publish.
deploy.targets.title: Your servers
deploy.targets.empty: No server yet. Add the server where your site should live. Somnia keeps the key in your computer's keychain.
deploy.kind.static.desc: HTML, CSS and files. The simple path.
deploy.kind.node.desc: A Node server app with server rendering. Runs as a service on the server.
deploy.kind.upload.desc: Only copies files. Somnia does not set up or change the web server.
deploy.delete.title: Remove server
deploy.delete.key: Also delete its key from the keychain
deploy.delete.note: Your site on the server stays online. Only this computer forgets the server.
deploy.step.key.title: 1. Create a key for Somnia
deploy.step.key.text: Somnia makes a key that never leaves your computer's keychain. You add its public half to the server.
deploy.key.add: Add this line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the user {user} on the server. It is safe to share: it is only the public half.
deploy.key.gone: The public key was shown when it was created. To get a new one, remove this server with its key and add it again.
deploy.step.trust.title: 2. Check the server
deploy.step.trust.text: Somnia connects once and shows the server's fingerprint, so you can confirm it is really your server.
deploy.step.ready.title: Ready to publish
deploy.step.ready.text: Somnia builds your site, shows what changes and asks before anything is uploaded.
deploy.staged: An assistant prepared a publish for {name} with {count} changes. Nothing has been uploaded. Press Publish to review it.
deploy.err.unsafe: Check the live site before you continue.
deploy.err.unknown: Something went wrong. Nothing was changed on your site.
deploy.err.invalid-input: Some details of this server are not valid. Check the address, user and domain.
deploy.err.target-not-found: This server is no longer saved on this computer.
deploy.err.storage: Somnia could not save the server list.
deploy.err.key-missing: The key for this server is gone from this computer.
deploy.err.key-exists: This server already has a key.
deploy.err.key-backend: Your computer's keychain did not accept the key. Unlock it and try again.
deploy.err.host-key-changed: This server now identifies itself differently. This can happen after a reinstall, or if someone is intercepting the connection.
deploy.err.host-key-already-pinned: This server is already trusted. Try again.
deploy.err.host-key-mismatch: The server showed a different fingerprint than the one you confirmed. Nothing was trusted.
deploy.err.not-acknowledged: The key was not replaced because the box was not ticked.
deploy.err.unknown-plan: That plan is no longer current. Start the publish again.
deploy.err.confirmation-invalid: The confirmation expired. Start the publish again.
deploy.err.plan-changed: The site or the server changed while you were reviewing. Nothing was uploaded. Review the new changes.
deploy.err.busy: Another publish for this server is still running.
deploy.err.connect-failed: Can't reach the server. Check the address and that the server is on.
deploy.err.auth-failed: The server did not accept Somnia's key.
deploy.err.host-key-rejected: The server's key did not match the saved one, so Somnia stopped.
deploy.err.preflight-failed: This server isn't ready for Somnia yet, or it has no space left. Nothing was changed.
deploy.err.switch-failed: Somnia could not switch to the new version.
deploy.err.health-failed-rolled-back: The new version didn't answer correctly, so Somnia went back to the last version.
deploy.err.health-failed-rollback-failed: The new version didn't answer and Somnia couldn't switch back automatically.
deploy.err.no-such-release: That version is no longer on the server.
deploy.err.engine-failed: Something went wrong while talking to the server. Nothing was changed on your site.

deploy.err.node-missing: Node.js is not installed on this server. Install it with: sudo apt-get install -y nodejs npm
deploy.err.node-too-old: The Node.js on this server is older than this app needs. Update it, then publish again.
deploy.err.install-failed: Installing the app's packages on the server failed. Nothing was changed.
deploy.err.health-failed: The app did not start on the server. It was stopped and nothing is live yet.

deploy.setup.title: Set up publishing
deploy.setup.desc: Prepare your own server once, then publish with a reviewed file list.
deploy.setup.key.title: Create a key for Somnia
deploy.setup.key.text: The private key stays in your computer's credential store. Only the public key goes on the server.
deploy.setup.trust.title: Verify your server first
deploy.setup.trust.text: Compare its fingerprint with your provider's console before trusting it. No password is sent before this check.
deploy.setup.prepare.title: Prepare the server once
deploy.setup.prepare.text: Review the full script. Run it in your provider's console with sudo, or use the password form below. Somnia will not replace another web server.
deploy.setup.domain.title: Point your domain at the server
deploy.setup.domain.text: Add these records in your domain provider's DNS settings. DNS checks use your system resolver and Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS.
deploy.setup.credentials: Passwords are used for this connection only, not saved. Deployments afterwards use the somnia account.
deploy.setup.reviewed: I reviewed the script and want to run it on {host}.
deploy.setup.ports: Open inbound TCP ports 80 and 443 in your provider firewall and server firewall. Somnia does not probe public port reachability or change firewall rules.
deploy.setup.already: I ran the script / server already prepared
deploy.setup.noDomain: Add a domain for trusted HTTPS. An IP alone is not enough.
deploy.setup.name: Name
deploy.setup.dnsNotReady: {domain} does not point at your server yet.
deploy.setup.staleIpv6: An AAAA record points elsewhere. Remove it or set it to this server's IPv6 address.
deploy.setup.wwwMissing: www has no address yet. Add the www record or a CNAME to your domain.
deploy.setup.resolverFailed: A DNS resolver did not answer. Readiness could not be verified.
deploy.setup.propagation: DNS changes can take a few hours. Publishing anyway can leave HTTPS unavailable until DNS and firewall settings are correct. Caddy retries certificates automatically.
deploy.setup.working: Checking your server. Setup can take several minutes.
deploy.setup.outcome.done: Server prepared. Future publishes run as somnia.
deploy.setup.outcome.sudo-denied: Sudo was refused. Check the password and this login's sudo access.
deploy.setup.outcome.unsupported-server: Use Debian or Ubuntu with systemd, on x86_64 or arm64.
deploy.setup.outcome.port-in-use: Another web server uses port {port}. Somnia did not replace it.
deploy.setup.outcome.failed: Server setup did not finish. Review the script and retry in your provider's console.
deploy.setup.error.failed: Could not complete this check. Your credentials were not saved.
deploy.setup.error.clipboard: Could not copy. Select and copy the text manually.
deploy.setup.error.host-key-unknown: Verify and trust the server fingerprint before setup.
deploy.setup.error.host-key-changed: The server identity changed. Setup stopped before sending credentials.
deploy.setup.error.auth-failed: The server refused this SSH login. Check the login and password.
deploy.setup.error.connect-failed: Could not reach the SSH server. Check its address and SSH port.
deploy.setup.notPrepared: This server is not prepared for Somnia yet.
deploy.setup.change.ports: Checks ports 80 and 443 without replacing another web server.
deploy.setup.change.key: Adds only the public key to authorized_keys.
deploy.setup.change.config: Sets up the Caddy service and private reload socket.
deploy.setup.change.start: Starts Caddy as somnia with permission to bind web ports.
deploy.setup.change.linger: Keeps Node user services running after logout.
deploy.err.dns-not-ready: The domain does not point at your server yet.
